card.name: Nouns completing biomedical noun phrases
card.fires_on: Fires on the last word or piece of a technical noun phrase, such as synthesis, gene, expression, meaning, or the end of a scale or drug name. It appears in scientific and label text, where the next word is often a new clause or a bracketed reference.
